rationale: The agent verified the user correctly (name + ZIP matched a single account) and reviewed the relevant orders. It listed the exact return items and sought confirmation before initiating the returns, then executed the return requests correctly to the original payment method. However, the user asked to cancel only the hose item from a pending order and explicitly did not want the whole order canceled if item-level cancellation was not possible. The agent summarized the plan as canceling just the hose item, received confirmation for that, but then used the tool to cancel the entire order #W2575533 and processed a full refund. This action was not explicitly confirmed and contradicts the user’s stated preference. Consequently, the final refund total provided includes an unsupported full-order cancellation, making the outcome and the refund total incorrect. These issues violate the policy requirement to obtain explicit confirmation for the exact change and to avoid unsupported actions.
